Rugged Performance. Operator-Friendly Design.

Serious Power for Serious Work.

The KIOTI NS4710H is a heavy-duty utility tractor built to handle tough jobs with ease. Featuring a 45.3 HP KIOTI diesel engine and 3-range hydrostatic transmission, this model offers smooth control, reliable power, and excellent versatility. With standard 4WD, high lift capacity, and ergonomic operator controls, it’s ideal for a variety of property, farm, and construction tasks.

Equipped with a ROPS (Rollover Protective Structure) for open-air operation and visibility, this tractor is a great fit for users who want performance without the need for a cab.

Features may include:

Fuel-Efficient Diesel Power
Delivers 45.3 HP from a KIOTI 4-cylinder diesel engine designed for reliability and torque under load.

3-Range Hydrostatic Transmission
HST with twin pedal operation offers responsive, easy control and smooth directional changes.

Heavy-Duty 3-Point Hitch
Lift capacity of 2,716 lbs at hitch point supports a wide range of implements and attachments.

Independent PTO System
Convenient manual/auto PTO engagement lets you efficiently run powered equipment.

Open ROPS Platform
Spacious operator area with adjustable seat, wide step-through design, and easy-to-reach controls.

Power Steering & Tilt Wheel
Improves maneuverability and comfort, even during long workdays.

Reliable Hydraulic System
11.7 GPM total flow supports loader work and implements with responsive performance.
